layman_headline: Fearful market offers no clean new entries — holding existing positions and watching closely.
layman_explanation: The overall crypto market is in a 'Fear' state with Bitcoin down nearly 3% over the week. Our two current trades — Solana and Chainlink — are both slightly underwater but well within their stop-loss ranges. The swing trade candidates on today's watchlist are either wildly overbought after 100%+ rallies (VELVET, H, AKE) or lack enough technical data to build conviction (FET, INJ). There's no setup right now that offers a clean risk/reward entry worth deploying fresh capital into.
layman_action: Stay patient. Keep holding SOL and LINK as both are near entry prices with stops intact. Wait for either our targets to hit or for a better buying opportunity to emerge in the next few days.
expert_reasoning: The swing candidates are split into two unattractive groups: (1) Parabolic movers like VELVET (+113% 7d), H (+114% 7d), and AKE (+153% 7d, RSI 92) that carry extreme correction risk — entering these after such moves violates swing trading discipline. (2) Beaten-down alts like FET (-96% from ATH) and INJ (-92% from ATH) that lack RSI data, MACD confirmation, or any identifiable reversal catalyst. With BTC dominance at 56.2% and Fear & Greed at 34, the environment heavily favors Bitcoin over alts. Both existing positions (SOL at -1%, LINK at -2%) are consolidating near entry and have intact stop-losses, so patience is warranted. The institutional news flow (UBS increasing BTC ETF exposure, Paul Tudor Jones adding to BlackRock BTC ETF) is BTC-positive but doesn't translate into a clear alt trade setup.
risk_factors: BTC breaking below $60K could drag SOL and LINK through their stop-losses
High BTC dominance (56.2%) continues to suppress altcoin performance

market_context: The crypto market sits in a cautious 'Fear' zone at 34/100 with BTC dominance elevated at 56.2%, signaling capital rotation away from alts. Institutional interest in Bitcoin ETFs (UBS, Paul Tudor Jones) is notable but hasn't translated to broader market confidence yet.
context_banner: Fearful markets with high BTC dominance demand patience — no high-conviction alt setups available this cycle.
